mechanism: Both agents can reduce heart rate and blood pressure; eplerenone may increase potassium levels which could be relevant in cardiac contexts, and systemic absorption of ophthalmic timolol may enhance beta-blockade effects.
action: Monitor heart rate, blood pressure, and serum potassium levels; assess for signs of excessive bradycardia or hypotension; ophthalmic timolol has minimal systemic absorption but caution warranted in patients with cardiac conduction abnormalities.
